name: ctree
description: The repository's git graph beside the conversation, following Claude's git commands: a guard on destructive ones, a journal that undoes them, search, compare, stashes; branch, tag and push once you confirm

guard.title: Guard
guard.description: Ask before Claude runs a git command that would lose work (reset --hard, checkout --, clean -f, stash drop, push --force, branch -D…)

language.title: Language
language.description: The pane's language: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, else the system locale (LANG); notes to Claude stay in English
